settings.title: A place comes first
settings.text: Black sand, cold stone, a garden in late sun. Each fragrance starts from one setting and stays true to it.
settings.alt: Oud of Dark Paradise standing on dark sand in a beam of light

settings.title: Materials from that world
settings.text: Tobacco leaf and moss, bergamot and jasmine, oud wood and sea salt. The notes follow the place.
settings.alt: Tobacco Enigma surrounded by moss, bergamot, lemon, cinnamon and jasmine

settings.title: A bottle of its own
settings.text: No shared flacon. Each fragrance gets its own glass, cap and colour, so you can tell them apart on the shelf.
settings.alt: Shamamah with its crystal cap among golden lilies

settings.name: Oud Fury
settings.line: Amber smoke, charred wood and a single shaft of evening light.
settings.alt: Oud Fury Eau de Parfum in its campaign setting

settings.name: Maha
